_meta.note: Growth, maturity and volume use falcata, a fast plantation species; cutting-cycle values come from a dipterocarp forest. State this as an assumption in the limitations.
_meta.growth_fit: Chapman-Richards f(t) = (1 - exp(-k*t))^p, least-squares fit to the normalized curve (t/t_mature)^0.4925 over 0..t_mature. Max abs error 0.082, RMSE 0.034; f(t_mature) = 0.918. k scales as 2.244 / t_mature.

a_m_m3_tree_day.source: value: Marryanna et al. (2023); bounds: Jordan & Kline (1978) [verify year]

t_mature_years.source: Alipon et al. (2016); default is the midpoint, project-defined

growth.source: curve: Uriarte & Pinol (1996), height = 7.9 * age^0.4925; form: Richards (1959); k and p fitted by the project

points.basis: COA 2012 sample (measured), as reported by PIDS
COA 2013 audit (measured), as reported by the Senate Economic Planning Office
National Greening Program target, not an observation

sigma.source: titles, years and report numbers still to be verified
